scenario: The ego vehicle enters and navigates a roundabout while two adversarial vehicles also enter and circulate within the same junction.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward and enters the roundabout, then continues along the circular path to exit the junction.

adversarials.behavior: The car enters the roundabout from the left side of the ego vehicle at approximately the same time as the ego, then navigates the circular junction.
The car is already navigating within the roundabout ahead of the ego vehicle, traveling along the circular path before the ego enters the junction.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle and the left-side adversarial car approach a multi-lane roundabout from different incoming roads, while the ahead adversarial car is already circulating within the roundabout's inner lane; all three vehicles share the same circular junction.
requirements_and_restrictions: Initial distances to the roundabout entry are defined for the ego and the left-side adversarial car, with the ahead adversarial car already positioned within the roundabout; the scenario terminates once the ego vehicle has successfully exited the roundabout.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned near the roundabout entry points on the roadside.
Placed along the sidewalks surrounding the roundabout.

Chronology: initially ego and left car approach roundabout separately while ahead car is inside; midpoint all three circulate the roundabout; ending ego exits while others continue. 4.
